title_en: 2026 Global Women's Leadership Scholarship (Women Professors' Association)
summary: Female master's and doctoral students currently enrolled at Seoul National University whose grade point average in the previous semester was 3.0 or higher may apply for a scholarship of KRW 2,000,000, either as students of foreign nationality (Type 1) or as Korean students raising children of elementary school age or younger (Type 2). Applicants must send a transcript, a certificate of enrollment, the application form and a recommendation letter from their academic advisor by email by 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday, 14 October 2026; the email address is in the original notice. Final recipients must attend the award ceremony at 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, 26 November 2026.
applies_to: Optional (by application). Female graduate students currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program at Seoul National University with a grade point average of 3.0 or higher in the previous semester, who also fall under one of two types: Type 1, female graduate students of foreign nationality; or Type 2, Korean female graduate students who are raising a child or children of elementary school age or younger while pursuing their studies.

dates.what: Scholarship award ceremony (attendance mandatory for final recipients)

conditions: Applicants must be female graduate students currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program at Seoul National University.
Applicants must have a grade point average of 3.0 or higher in the previous semester.
Applicants must be either a foreign national (Type 1) or a Korean national raising a child or children of elementary school age or younger while studying (Type 2).
A total of 15 students will be selected, and the final number selected for each type will be decided by the review results.
The application form and the advisor's recommendation letter must be prepared on the designated forms.
Applications must be submitted by email; the deadline is 11:59 p.m. on 14 October 2026.
Final recipients must attend the award ceremony.
steps: Read the two attached files (an English and a Korean image of the announcement); their content was not read for this translation.

Download the designated application form and advisor recommendation form from the Google Drive folder linked in the notice: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MVBbC-xuAEF7ulXNvgVy6LRjhLRqtjv4?usp=sharing
Prepare your transcript, certificate of enrollment, completed application form and a recommendation letter from your academic advisor on the designated form.
Email all documents to the address given in the original notice by 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday, 14 October 2026.
If you are selected as a final recipient, attend the award ceremony at 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, 26 November 2026.
translation:
Title: [Women Professors' Association (여교수회)] 2026 Global Women's Leadership Scholarship

[2026 Global Women's Leadership Scholarship]

- Scholarship amount: KRW 2,000,000 per person

- Eligibility: Female graduate students currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program at Seoul National University with a grade point average of 3.0 or higher in the previous semester
  · Type 1: Female graduate students of foreign nationality
  · Type 2: Korean female graduate students who are raising a child or children of elementary school age or younger while pursuing their studies

- Number of recipients: 15 in total
  ※ The final number of recipients for each type will be determined according to the review results.

- Required documents: Transcript, certificate of enrollment, application form*, recommendation letter from academic advisor* (*Please download the designated forms for the application form and the recommendation letter.)
  > Application document forms: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MVBbC-xuAEF7ulXNvgVy6LRjhLRqtjv4?usp=sharing

- Application deadline: Wednesday, 14 October 2026, 11:59 p.m.

- Submission method: By email (the email address is given in the original notice).

- Scholarship award ceremony: Thursday, 26 November 2026, 5:00 p.m. ※ Attendance is mandatory for final recipients.
